name: EVE University
reason: for the [EVE University wiki](https://wiki.eveuniversity.org), whose [constellation layouts for incursions](https://wiki.eveuniversity.org/Constellation_layouts_for_Incursions) map where the incursion sites spawn across null-, low- and high-sec, shared under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
